items.title: Forehead reduction
items.description:
Forehead reduction surgery, also known as hairline lowering, is a specialized cosmetic procedure designed to create a more balanced and harmonious facial appearance. This procedure involves carefully advancing the scalp forward to reduce the height of the forehead, resulting in improved facial proportions and enhanced confidence.

Performed with precision and attention to detail, forehead reduction is ideal for individuals with a naturally high hairline or those seeking a more youthful, aesthetically pleasing look. The surgery is tailored to each patientâ€™s unique facial structure, ensuring natural-looking results with minimal visible scarring.

Our approach prioritizes safety, artistry, and patient satisfactionâ€”combining advanced surgical techniques with personalized care to achieve refined, elegant outcomes.

items.title: Arm lift
items.description:
Arm lift surgery (brachioplasty) is a cosmetic procedure designed to reshape and contour the upper arms by removing excess skin and fat. It is especially beneficial for individuals who have experienced significant weight loss or natural skin laxity due to aging, resulting in a sagging or â€œbat wingâ€ appearance.

During the procedure, excess tissue is carefully removed, and the remaining skin is tightened to create a smoother, firmer, and more toned arm contour. The technique is customized to each patientâ€™s anatomy and goals, ensuring balanced, natural-looking results.

An arm lift can significantly enhance the overall silhouette, allowing patients to feel more confident in wearing fitted or sleeveless clothing. Our approach combines advanced surgical techniques with meticulous care to achieve safe, refined, and long-lasting outcomes.
